anya: Need quick sync: final hero copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Keep it crisp — devs + infra buyers.

mike: sharing current live briefly...

anya: Live: Hosted: 'Start building with our API in minutes' — Dedicated: 'Dedicated GPU capacity for production' — Private: 'Private deployment inside your network'

sophia: I recommend stronger verbs: Hosted -> 'Ship LLM features fast'. Dedicated -> 'Predictable capacity for production'. Private -> 'Inference inside your network'.

jared: SEO note: target keywords are 'low-latency inference', 'dedicated gpu inference', 'private LLM deployment' — put them in meta, not hero.

mike: Drafts with CTAs:
Hosted: Headline: 'Ship LLM features fast' — Subhead: 'Instant API, scale on demand, predictable per-token cost.' — CTA: 'Get started' / 'See benchmarks'
Dedicated: Headline: 'Predictable capacity for production' — Subhead: 'Reserved GPU pools, SLA-backed latency, autoscale policies.' — CTA: 'Request dedicated capacity' / 'View SLA'
Private: Headline: 'Inference under your control' — Subhead: 'On-prem or VPC deployment with KMS and audit logs.' — CTA: 'Request private deployment' / 'Deployment options'

olivia: A/B plan: Variant A action-led (Ship / Predictable / Control), Variant B outcome-led (Build faster / Lower costs / Keep data onsite). Track hero_click, secondary_cta, demo_request. UTM=marketing.hero_test

sophia: I'll draft meta titles/descriptions and OG text. Example meta for Hosted: 'Hosted API  Instant low-latency inference with predictable per-token cost.'

jared: I'll add keyword doc to the PR. Keep hero copy clean.
